messages:
Anna (Sales): Hey team — customer X is asking for a tight handshake before we start a paid POC. Need to align success criteria + any obvious blockers. They want 3-week runway, private VPC, and SLOs for latency/cost/quality. Can we list must-haves and a quick acceptance gate?

Ben (Solutions Eng): Quick summary of their use cases: 1) customer support summarization (short answers), 2) realtime chat assistant (multi-turn), 3) automated invoice data extraction (structured).

Carla (AE): Budget constraint: ~$8k/mo for the POC (their internal cap). They expect metrics to show <200ms p95 for support answers and <1200ms for multi-turn chat. Also want per-invocation cost estimates.

Ben (Solutions Eng): Notes: latency targets look tight for hosted inference at that budget depending on traffic. For 200ms p95 we should plan on smaller model or dedicated GPU pool with optimized quantization. Can propose a canary: host search summarization + invoice parsing on Dedicated (reserved micro-pool) and chat on Hosted with fallback to smaller variant.

James (SRE): Security checklist: must support VPC peering, customer-managed KMS for keys, and audit logs retained 90 days. Also need inbound IP allowlist for their environment. If they require air-gapped on-prem, that'll move to Private and timeline extends by ~3 weeks.

Carla (AE): They flagged an internal security questionnaire item: "Where are tokens persisted?" — we need a plain answer for legal. Can someone paste the standard line?

Ben (Solutions Eng): Standard line: "We do not persist user inputs in public datasets. Request logs are stored encrypted at rest; KV cache can be configured to TTL <24h or disabled. Keys are customer-managed in KMS if requested."

Anna (Sales): Great. For acceptance criteria, propose:
- Use case coverage: demo run against their 50-case prompt suite (they'll supply).
- Quality: support summaries have >=0.75 ROUGE-L (or 85% human accept rate), invoice extraction F1 >= 0.92.
- Latency: support responses p95 <200ms, chat p95 <1200ms.
- Cost: monthly projected infra <= $8k for observed traffic profile.
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during business hours.

James (SRE): Those are reasonable. Add operational gates: healthcheck endpoint, per-route metrics exported, and an escalation contact. Also add rollback policy: auto-fallback to baseline smaller model if p95 exceeds target for >5min.

Carla (AE): Timeline suggestion: Week 0: infra + security signoff (VPC/KMS). Week 1: load/latency baseline + prompt tuning. Week 2: evaluation with their prompt suite + final acceptance. 3-week paid POC fits if infra signoff is fast.

Anna (Sales): Action items — @Ben to draft POC runbook + config (batching, quant profiles), @James to confirm VPC peering steps and KMS flow, @Carla to confirm budget approval and collect prompt suite. I'll consolidate and send to the customer.

DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: redwood/dedicated-poc -> staging at 2024-11-18T14:02Z (link: https://deploys.redwood.example/abcd). :rocket:

Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll include estimated token burn and per-1M-token cost scenarios (hosted vs dedicated). Will call out tradeoffs: lower latency costs more; batching helps cost but hurts single-request latency.

Anna (Sales): Perfect. If anyone sees a hard blocker (security or budget) shout now, otherwise I'll ship the SOW draft by EOD and ask them to sign infra access forms. :thumbsup:

James (SRE): One potential blocker: if their firewall doesn't allow peering, we need to switch to Private — note that asap. Otherwise all good.
